answer.justification: The activation measurements match the system-prompted profile. Layer-1 relative L2 is 0.139, rising steeply with onset at layer 8 to a plateau of about 0.50 at layers 16-24 and 0.527 at layer 32. The layer-2 spike of 31.2 is far above the quantized (0.8-2.8) and fine-tuned (0.7-6.1) ranges. Final cosine 0.835, effective rank 2.86, direction consistency 0.543 and size ratio 0.973 (below 1) also fit system-prompted. Fine-tuned is ruled out because its size ratio is above 1 and its layer-16 values are lower. Quantized is ruled out by the plateau shape and the small spike. Several values sit slightly outside the documented ranges, but this is a single draw. Base is excluded because the differences are non-zero.
